_primary_source_opened.evidence: Document opened via python-docx; Appendix 7 BCU Calculation Methodology paragraphs 219-271 read. Key equation at para 263-264: Net CO2eFD = (CO2eTransport + CO2eOn-Site) - (AERD * MassRD). CO2eTransport defined as transport-fuel-use process emissions only. Embodied vehicle emissions not in scope of BCU equation.

pdd_appendix_7_bcu_eligibility.rule_summary: BCUs offset fossil-diesel-use process emissions only (Distance-Based Method transport process + on-site diesel). Embodied vehicle emissions (vehicle manufacturing amortized per-mile) are not in the BCU equation — they aren't fuel-replaceable by renewable diesel.
